translations.web: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
translations.bsb: For we maintain that a man is justified by faith apart from works of the law.
translations.kjv: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
translations.asv: We reckon therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
